The climate in Lisbon

Lisbon is about 66 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 28°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 9°C. Around 540 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in October (about 78 mm). The highest temperature in Lisbon in 2015–2024 was 42°C (4 August 2018) and the lowest 1°C (20 January 2017).

Best time to visit Lisbon

The most pleasant weather in Lisbon is usually in May, June, July, September and October: average highs are between 23°C and 28°C, with up to 9 days of rain a month.
